info.name: Marketo Engage Rest Approve Smart  Lists API
Marketo Get Smart List by Id

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the smart list to retrieve

params.name: includeRules
params.description: Set true to populate smart list rules. Default false

items.docs: Retrieves a Smart List record by its id. Required Permissions: Read-Asset or Read-Write Asset

params.name: id
params.description: Id of the smart list to delete

items.docs: Deletes the designated Smart List. Required Permissions: Read-Write Asset

params.name: folder
params.description: JSON representation of parent folder, with members 'id', and 'type' which may be 'Folder' or 'Program'

params.name: maxReturn
params.description: Maximum number of smart lists to return. Max 200, default 20.

params.name: earliestUpdatedAt
params.description: Exclude smart lists prior to this date. Must be valid ISO-8601 string. See Datetime field type description.

params.name: latestUpdatedAt
params.description: Exclude smart lists after this date. Must be valid ISO-8601 string. See Datetime field type description.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of user created Smart List records. Required Permissions: Read-Asset or Read-Write Asset

params.name: id
params.description: Id of smart list to clone

items.docs: Clones the designated Smart List. Required Permissions: Read-Write Asset
